Low Poly 3D Dice source
=======================

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/low-poly-3d-dice
Author listed on OpenGameArt: Facehunter2003
License listed on OpenGameArt: CC0

P_RD usage:
- The original archive is kept here for license/source traceability.
- CombatDiceRollStageActor uses the CC0 DAE mesh vertex/triangle data for d4, d6, d8, d12, and d20 presentation meshes.
- d2 is presented as a coin-shaped two-sided die because the source pack does not include a d2.
- No new project texture or material asset is created from this source in the current test implementation.
